evidence.quote: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-1/2 to 1-3/4 percent
The Committee will continue to monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook as it assesses the appropriate path of the target range for the federal funds rate.
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent.
Although household spending has been rising at a strong pace, business fixed investment and exports remain weak.
In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures

parsed.rationale: The statement announces a rate cut justified by global risks and muted inflation, which is dovish. However, the forward guidance is neutral and contains no explicit easing bias, implying a pause, and two members dissented in favor of holding, which moderates the dovish signal.
